Next year will mark the 20th anniversary of the iPhone's launch, and rumours suggest the iPhone Pro models will feature a completely refreshed design. The latest leak has revealed what are claimed to be larger screen sizes for the upcoming line-up.

iPhone Pro models next year to come with larger 6.4-inch and 7-inch displays

In 2017, when the iPhone celebrated its 10th anniversary, Apple had a very special model in store: the iPhone X.

There are rumours the company is preparing a similarly unique offering for the 20th anniversary next year.

Reportedly, next year's iPhone Pro models will adopt a bezel-less, four-corner curved display with the screen extending to the edges of the body.

The Dynamic Island's cutout may be shrunk or even removed, giving the device a seamless all-glass,一体式 appearance.

According to the latest post by leaker Digital Chat Station, Apple will also introduce brand-new screen sizes. He says the company is testing the following specifications:

  • iPhone Pro: 6.4-inch, up from the current 6.3-inch
  • iPhone Pro Max: 7-inch, up from the current 6.9-inch

He added that both devices will have larger overall bodies, but will maintain the same aspect ratio as current models. So the increase in screen size does not appear to come solely from slimmer bezels.

Apple last adjusted the screen sizes of its Pro models in 2024, when the iPhone 16 Pro went from 6.1-inch to 6.3-inch, and the Pro Max went from 6.7-inch to 6.9-inch.

Although next year's size adjustment sounds modest, the four-corner curved design should make the overall look feel more groundbreaking.

What do you think about the rumoured design of next year's iPhone Pro models? Let us know in the comments.
